title: Signal Snapshot (draft)
description: DRAFT. A set of observed signals for a single subject at a single block height. Field names and value domains are under research and are not final. No thresholds are defined in this repository; a snapshot therefore records the threshold that was applied rather than referencing a canonical one.

schema_version.description: Draft revision of the snapshot format. Not a released version number.

subject.description: What the signals describe. A snapshot covers exactly one subject.

identifier.description: Reaction identifier or creator address. Creator identity is an unresolved problem; see research/creator-attribution.md.

attribution_confidence.description: Only meaningful for kind=creator. Records how the subject was resolved. 'declared' and 'heuristic' carry materially different weight and must not be presented identically.

observed_at.description: Chain position at which the snapshot was computed. A signal without a block height is not reproducible.

confirmations.description: Confirmations behind tip at evaluation. Consumers may reject snapshots below their own finality requirement.

signals.description: Observed labels. An empty array means no catalogued condition was observed - it does not mean the opposite of any label holds.

metrics.description: Raw derived values behind the labels, published so a reader can check the underlying fact. Intentionally open: the metric set is under research.

notes.description: Free-text annotation. Not interpreted. Used to mark illustrative snapshots as non-normative.

label.description: Catalogued condition. See catalog/signals.md. Labels are descriptive, never predictive or evaluative.

window.description: Block range the derivation covered. Required even for point-in-time signals, where from_block equals to_block.

threshold_applied.description: The threshold used to produce this label. Recorded per snapshot because no canonical thresholds exist; this makes a disputed label checkable.

expression.description: Human-readable statement of the condition tested.

status.description: Every threshold in this repository is 'unresolved'. 'provisional' and 'agreed' are reserved for future use and are not in use.

observed_value.description: The measured value that met the threshold, as a decimal string to avoid float precision loss.

limitations.description: Known weaknesses of this particular observation.
